description: AI-powered product where the AI is the core experience. Industry brain defines the domain the AI operates in. This core defines how AI interaction, generation, and configuration work.

relationships: Message is either from User or from AI
Generation is the AI output from a Message or Prompt
Prompt is a saved input created by User
Model is the AI model configuration — version, temperature, context length
Usage tracks tokens consumed and cost per User or Organisation
APIKey belongs to User or Organisation — grants programmatic access
Project groups Conversations by topic or purpose
Template is a reusable Prompt created by User
Output is a saved Generation — image, text, code, or file
Feedback belongs to Message — thumbs up or down plus optional note

mvp.description: Core AI interaction — chat with AI, get generations, view history.
primary_flows: Sign up → start new conversation → type prompt → receive AI generation → continue conversation
View conversation history → open past conversation → continue from where left off

interaction_patterns: Streaming text output — AI response types character by character
Stop generation button appears during streaming
Copy button appears on hover or tap of any AI message
Regenerate button below each AI response
Conversation auto-titled from first message
Input bar expands vertically as user types multi-line prompt
Code blocks in responses — syntax highlighted, copy button in corner
Feedback thumbs — up fills green, down fills red on tap

startup.description: Full AI tool with prompt library, projects, file uploads, image generation, and team sharing.
primary_flows: Create project → organise conversations → set project-level system prompt → generate within project context
Upload file or image → reference in prompt → AI analyses and responds
Use prompt template → customise variables → send → save output
Share conversation or output → recipient views without account
secondary_flows: Set up custom persona or assistant
Export conversation as PDF or markdown

scale.description: Enterprise AI platform with team workspaces, API access, custom models, compliance, and admin.
primary_flows: Enterprise admin deploys custom model → sets org-level system prompt → team uses with shared context
API user generates key → builds integration → monitors usage via API → stays within limits
Team shares project → all members add to same conversation history → collaborative AI workspace
Compliance admin reviews conversation logs → exports audit report → satisfies enterprise policy
Admin monitors all usage → sets per-user limits → prevents cost overruns
secondary_flows: Rate limiting per team or user

interaction_patterns: All MVP and Startup interaction patterns
Workspace switcher — org name at top of sidebar — dropdown to switch
Per-user usage bar — fills as user approaches limit — amber at 80%, red at 95%
Custom model status badge — training spinner, deployed green, archived grey
Org template approval chip — pending yellow, approved green, rejected red
API key — partially masked by default, tap to reveal with biometric confirm
Fine-tuning progress step bar — data upload, training, evaluation, deploy
Compliance mode — conversation view with user identity redacted
Budget alert banner on admin dashboard when org spend approaches limit
